= C4 Through PlantUML

C4 is not a diagram type. It is a PlantUML standard library, reached with `!include`, and
the gem's jar carries it -- which is why `c4plantuml` was removed from SUPPORTED_TYPES
rather than given a renderer. It had never been a block type at all: a `[c4plantuml]`
block is not recognised by anything, so it failed with an empty message.

The help text tells readers to write C4 this way. This fixture is what keeps that
sentence from becoming a claim nobody checks.

[plantuml]
----
@startuml
!include <C4/C4_Container>
Person(user, "Reader", "Reads the documentation")
@enduml
----
